Name: Rescue: Captured Pilot on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Local Contract. One of our pilots is held at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>. Recover her alive. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: A pilot set down near the <Alias=TargetLocation> to wait out a fault, and whoever holds it took her inside. She is still alive.
I've dealt with the guard captain at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. Now I need to find the terminal that opens the pilot's cell.
I opened the cell from the terminal. The pilot is free, and I need to talk to her.
A pilot was taken at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. I killed the guard captain, opened her cell, and she went to see about her ship.

Objectives.DisplayText: Defeat the guard captain at the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're not one of them. They never opened that door without shouting first. I set down to fix a coolant fault.
Let's get you out of here.
Yes. Please. And if my ship's still out there, I'm taking it. Coolant fault and all.
Not really. They mostly argued about what I was worth. The number kept going down. That was the worst part.
Why set down here at all?
The fault picked the spot, not me. I'd have liked somewhere quieter.
If you're here to feed me again, I'll pass.
Our pilot's in there somewhere, and they'll keep her near whoever's in charge. Bring her home. The ship I can replace.
That one was in charge. Her cell runs off their terminal, so open it.
